extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4. Multi-country Communication: only passages about North Macedonia and horizontal passages addressed to all Western Balkan or enlargement partners within Chapter 2 (as bounded in the run record) or the technology and AI theme were extracted. Method: keyword search over the whole file (country name, digital, cyber, AI, e-government, e-services, broadband, roaming, 5G, workers, social security, EURES, interoperability, electronic, data protection, connectivity, single market, technology) and full reading of every page with a hit, including the North Macedonia conclusions (paragraph 11, pages 23-24) and sections IV to VI. The annexes (third-party indicators and statistics) are listed at page 28 but are published separately (see MKD-EU-2024-003). Period covered left empty: the register gives none. Left out: digitalisation of the justice system and case management systems (page 9, back-office, R12); cybercrime (R21); general references to the green and digital transitions in the Growth Plan and Economic and Investment Plan. No North Macedonia-specific technology claim and no Chapter 2 material found in this document. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.

items.stated_text: Hybrid threats remain a political and security challenge for the enlargement countries, in particular for those in electoral cycles. items.stated_text: The measures for accelerated integration being launched so far include applications to join the Single Euro Payment Area (SEPA), Green Lanes to speed up goods clearance on EU - Western Balkans borders, dedicated Agreements on Conformity Assessment and Acceptance of Industrial Products, developing national identity wallets and a Balkan Digital identity wallet interoperable with the European Digital Identity Wallets, replicating the WiFi4EU initiative in the Western Balkans, inclusion of the region in the European Digital Innovation Hubs, as well as cooperation under the Critical Medicines Alliance.
items.summary: Growth Plan integration measures launched include national identity wallets, a Balkan Digital identity wallet interoperable with EU wallets, WiFi4EU replication and European Digital Innovation Hubs.
